optional_setup.title: Alternative: tested Cursor CLI discovery and resume
optional_setup.description: Install the official Cursor CLI and sign in with agent login. Version 2026.10.01-e373342 was checked. actions.label: Resume the saved Cursor CLI assessment
actions.value: agent --resume SESSION_ID --model auto --mode ask --print --output-format stream-json --trust 'Use only this saved conversation, without any tools or new data.
